title: PCR Preparation Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input your protocol parameters as required.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file and unzip it if needed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware to OT App
steps.instruction: In the OT App, navigate to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select your labware JSON files (.json) if needed.

steps.title: Upload protocol file to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the protocol file (.py) to the OT App in the Protocol tab.

steps.title: Set up deck according to map
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck hardware following the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware, tiprack, and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate your labware, tiprack, and pipette using the OT App; consult support articles for calibration tips.
